description: Store a new episodic memory. Returns immediately with job_id and status queued; work runs on the plugin worker.
embedding_description: Queue a new episodic memory with content, optional tags and source_file. Returns job_id and status queued before embedding or storage runs. Read service_interface::job_service::get_job for the original response in job.result, including memory_id and message; failures also retain job.error.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job handle with job_id and status; the final response is stored in job.result.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Retain this exact job_id. Schedule job_service::get_job while queued or processing; inspect terminal result or error before using the final data. Do not repeat a write because a poll is delayed.
